spots.name: On the Same Team
spots.blurb: You've reached On the Same Team, a mural by Andrew Hem from 2021. At LA General Medical Center's Child Care Center, the mural depicts the bandstand and hotel turret from nearby Mariachi Plaza transported to a waterscape. Made of translucent smalti glass tiles, hand-crafted by mosaicists at Miotto Mosaic Art Studios.

spots.name: The Bright Forest
spots.blurb: You've reached The Bright Forest, a mural by Timbuctustate, Aly from 2016. At the Downtown Mental Health Clinic is a group of interior murals designed by artist Aly Timbuctustate and non-profit organization Now Art LA, in hopes to create a visual environment supporting the therapeutic process.

spots.name: Doolittle Raid Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Doolittle Raid Mural, a mural by Frank Ackerman from 1974. depicting the Doolittle Raid’s Mitchell B-25 bombers taking off from the USS Hornet as they begin their mission. The mural is based on several famous photographs taken by military personnel on the morning of the raid.
